description:
Get current Ethereum gas prices (slow, standard, fast)

Use when: You need to know current Ethereum gas prices before submitting a transaction or estimating costs.
Not for: you need gas as part of a broader read — market_snapshot already includes standard gwei; only Ethereum mainnet gas is reported.
Returns: slow_gwei, standard_gwei, fast_gwei, base_fee_gwei, estimated confirmation times
Example response: {"slow_gwei":1.5,"standard_gwei":2,"fast_gwei":3,"base_fee_gwei":1.2,"source":"etherscan"}

Price: $0.000 USDC per call
name: gas_tracker
